name: AVANT
description: NextGenerationEU cybersecurity project for Digital Twin systems. Designed and developed workflows to monitor a Digital Twin, model business cases and connected assets, simulate MITRE ATT&CK attack paths and countermeasures, and compare inherent and residual asset risks. Researched the Digital Twin domain to translate emerging concepts into an implementable platform solution.

name: ENCRYPT
description: Horizon Europe privacy risk assessment project developed within a consortium of organizations from across Europe. Built a web module that models domain-specific asset taxonomies, evaluates LINDDUN privacy impacts and exposure to MITRE ATT&CK techniques, calculates privacy risk scores, and summarizes assessment results through interactive charts.

name: PAB Goes Digital
description: Large Angular platform for digitizing provincial administrative processes used by citizens, businesses, and tax assistance centres. Introduced reactive forms, reusable modules, role-based access patterns, and shared components while working directly with the client in an Agile Scrum team.

name: FrancescoVicidomini.dev
description: Personal website used to experiment with modern web technologies and evolving front-end approaches. Originally developed with Angular, later rebuilt with React, and currently implemented with Next.js. Deployed on Vercel to gain hands-on experience with continuous integration and deployment workflows.

name: Knoxly
organization: Master's thesis · Università degli Studi di Salerno
description: Master's thesis privacy assistant for Telegram Web and Gmail. Built a two-stage text-classification pipeline using multilingual sentence embeddings and topic-specific sensitivity classifiers, exposed through a Flask API and integrated with a configurable Chrome extension.

name: ShareErasmus
description: Erasmus platform developed while acting as project manager for a team of eight people.

name: YASPL3
description: Designed a custom programming language and implemented its compiler in Java SE.

name: N-body Simulation
description: Parallel and concurrent N-body simulation with AWS cluster configuration and performance testing.
